basis: jinshu:053:s0031 explicitly identifies 詹事裴權 as the speaker warning that 賈謐 has favor in 中宮 and that 若一旦交構，大事去矣; s0032 continues his advice before s0033 says the prince did not follow. zizhitongjian:083:s0153 has the same 詹事裴權 remonstrating that 謐，后所親暱，一旦交構，則事危矣; s0154 repeats the refusal.

The complete Jinshu s0029–s0043 and Tongjian s0151–s0159 frames both begin with the prince refusing to indulge Jia Mi, describe Mi being left at the Eastern Palace while the prince plays, then give Pei Quan’s warning and ensuing slander to the empress. Exact full Chinese name, exact 詹事 office, same addressee and distinctive warning establish the same adviser, rather than merely homonymous officials.
